summary: Frontend-only usability validation for Vanguarda.IA. Tested new mobile drawer menu, Clients search, Generator image flow, and cross-page navigation. All requested flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Generator.jsx line 276: 'Refazer imagem' label logic (image ? Refazer : Gerar) verified via code review; not exercised end-to-end because AI image gen takes ~55s (as instructed to skip).

Clients.jsx line 151-155: 'clients-search-count' is only rendered when query (q) is non-empty. This matches good UX but the requirement text mentions 'mostrar contador'; consider whether a total count should also show when query is empty (currently only shown while filtering). Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile menu drawer works correctly at 390x844: trigger opens Sheet, all 9 nav items with data-testid `${testid}-mobile` (nav-dashboard-mobile, nav-clientes-mobile, nav-gerar-mobile, nav-pecas-mobile, nav-biblia-mobile, nav-campanhas-mobile, nav-logs-mobile, nav-configuracoes-mobile, nav-planos-mobile) and mobile-logout are present, clicking a nav item navigates and closes the drawer (drawer removed from DOM). NOTE: Radix Sheet renders in a portal; use page.evaluate + document.querySelector to check presence rather than Playwright's is_visible() which can return false on the animated container. Clients page has 133 seeded clients; search input filters correctly and clients-no-results shows for non-matching queries. Generator flow: activate generator-image-toggle BEFORE submitting text, generate-piece-submit-button triggers streaming text (~15-30s), then generate-image-button appears (label 'Gerar imagem' when no image, 'Refazer imagem' when image exists) and clicking it shows image-progress-bar. Navigation routes are PT-BR: /dashboard /clientes /gerar /pecas /biblia /campanhas /logs /configuracoes /planos (do NOT use /clients /generator /pieces etc.). No console/page errors observed.

detailed_results.mobile_menu_drawer: PASS - trigger opens, all 9 nav items + Sair button, clicking Clientes navigates to /clientes and closes drawer
detailed_results.clients_search: PASS - clients-search-input filters list, clients-search-count shows 'X de Y' while typing, clients-no-results shows for no match
detailed_results.generator_image_flow: PASS - toggle activates, text generates first, generate-image-button appears with label 'Gerar imagem', clicking shows image-progress-bar with % updates
detailed_results.navigation_smoke: PASS - /dashboard /pecas /biblia /campanhas /logs /configuracoes /planos all load with app-layout, no page errors
